Cube Cam

Photograph a scrambled 3×3, watch it solve in about 20 moves.

Warming up solver…
STEP 1

Scan each face

Turn the camera on once. Line each face up with the grid and tap Capture; the app tells you which face to show next.

Or photograph faces one at a time:

STEP 2

Check the colours

Tap any sticker to change its colour. Each colour should appear exactly 9 times.

STEP 3

Watch the solve

— Solve a cube to see the moves here.

Hold your real cube white on top, green facing you, and follow along.
